verdict.rationale: Sakana's own docs say Marlin produces a "fully referenced report" with a references section, and a customer testimonial praises the quantity and quality of cited information and its use of primary sources. What remains unproven is claim-level granularity: nothing shows inline citations tied to each substantive claim or a way to jump to the underlying source. Missing for 10: documentation of per-claim inline citation format, linking from claims to sources, independent or hands-on verification of citation coverage and accuracy.
